thread:
Mira: Hey team — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4261. Changes: add int8 quantized kernel path + small batching heuristic tweak. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes for canary/merge plan. Target merge window Wed 11:00 PT. @Alex @Sam @Priya @Jordan
Alex: thanks Mira — can you paste a 1‑line risk summary? does this touch any customer-facing API or just serving infra?
Mira: quick summary: runtime-only inference execution and scheduler selector changes. No API surface changes. Risk: cold-cache perf delta and fallback behavior for mixed-precision models. No KMS/HSM changes.
Sam: I can take runtime review but I'm tied up until ~noon PT today. If you need an owner for canary next week I can sign up.
Priya: does this require infra config (autoscaler, instance types) or new node labels? I can't approve infra touches without that detail.
Mira: infra notes: no new labels, but recommends bumping pooling max for dedicated pools by +1 for the canary. Patch adds a config flag: `batching.max_tokens_per_batch` default unchanged.
Jordan: from sec: confirm no key material touch and no telemetry endpoint changes. Also will need a quick threat check for model cache eviction changes.
Mira: confirmed no key material. Telemetry: adds one metric `serving.kv_evictions` (no PII). I'll send a short PR comment with the threat checklist.
deploy-bot: CI • build: passed • unit: passed • e2e-perf: flaky (1 failure) — please re-run after fixes.
Alex: re: e2e perf — @Mira can you run `./tools/e2e_perf --model small --runs 3` and paste output in PR?
Mira: running now, will paste results and re-run CI.
Sam: OK to own canary rollout. I'll coordinate with infra to schedule a low-traffic canary and monitor latency/cost metrics.
Priya: request: add a single-line infra playbook to the PR description (how to roll back pool size). I can approve infra once that's in.
Jordan: I'll do a quick security scan after Mira posts the threat checklist. If no issues, I'll lgtm.
Mira: added playbook + perf logs to PR, re-triggered CI. Thanks everyone — aiming to merge Wed 11:00 PT if all clear. :thumbsup:
